translated_title: Authorities Arrest "R2," Alleged Leader of "Los Rs" Linked to the Murder of Carlos Manzo; He Was Wounded in a Clash
original_title: Detienen al “R2”, presunto líder de “Los Rs”, ligado al asesinato de Carlos Manzo; resultó herido en enfrentamiento

meta_description: Captured in Zapopan along with 19 others in an operation backed by DEA intelligence, he is wanted for extradition by the United States.
